description: Distributed lock / lease lock (mutex) for AI agents: acquire, renew, release a named lock with TTL and a monotonic fencing token so only one agent runs a job at a time. Idempotent, shared by namespace, no Redis needed. Every call requires a tiny solved packet (returned in the reply, 2 s, one try); free first call, no API key (GET /try?tool=agent_lease_lock).
name: agent_lease_lock
title: agent_lease_lock
